lines: In the dark of night, the Children of Israel left Egypt. Men, women and children.
At sunrise, Pharaoh came after them with his whole army.
And now we are back where we began. The sea in front of them. The army behind.
"We are going to be overtaken!" "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord. He will guide me."
Then Allah inspired Musa: "Strike with your staff the sea." And it parted. And each side was like a great, towering mountain.
A dry path opened through the middle of the sea. And they walked across, all of them, without fear.
